newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries softer at close, 3-year demand soggy.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries softer at close, 3-year demand soggy.

text.p: *U.S. Treasuries mostly a bit lower. Three-year yield at 6.44 percent as expected but demand disappointing with 2.08x cover.
*World market buoyancy seen helping 10-year sale on Wednesday.
*Some 3-yr paper demand pre-auction to cover flat curve trades
*Market split on May 20 Fed. Greenspan eyed Thurs for clues.
